name: set
title: set — Variable Assignment and Declaration
summary: Binds an identifier to a computed expression, literal value, or data structure. Supports type annotations, immutable constraints, and reactive bindings.

functionalities.title: Standard Assignment
functionalities.desc: Binds a variable to a value in the current scope using colon assignment syntax.
functionalities.code:
set greeting : "Hello, VerScript!"
set count : 42
display greeting ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Explicit Type Constraint
functionalities.desc: Ensures the variable only accepts values matching the specified primitive or custom DataType.
functionalities.code:
set num score : 98.5
set str username : "alex_dev"
set arr matrix : [[1, 0], [0, 1]]

functionalities.title: Immutable Constant Declaration
functionalities.desc: Prevents reassignment throughout the lifecycle of the execution environment.
functionalities.code:
set const MAX_USERS : 1000
! MAX_USERS : 2000 -> throws ImmutableError

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.desc: The name of the variable to bind.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.desc: The evaluated value assigned to the variable.

parameters.name: type (optional)
parameters.desc: Enforces strict type contracts (num, str, bool, arr, entity).

returns: Returns the evaluated value assigned to the identifier.
example:
set num initialBalance : 500
set num deposit : 150
set num total : initialBalance + deposit
display "Total Account Balance: $" + total ?color=#22c55e

name: display
title: display — Standard Console & Terminal Output
summary: Streams evaluated arguments to standard output. Supports ANSI Truecolor hex styling, inline printing, formatting tags, and multiple arguments.

functionalities.title: Standard Output with Newline
functionalities.desc: Prints evaluated arguments separated by spaces, terminating with a newline character.
functionalities.code: display "Welcome to the VerScript Runtime!"

functionalities.title: ANSI Truecolor Styling
functionalities.desc: Applies 24-bit RGB/HEX color rendering to the output stream without manual escape sequences.
functionalities.code:
display "Status: Online" ?color=#00FFCC
display "Warning: High Latency" ?color=#f59e0b
display "Error: Connection Terminated" ?color=#ef4444

functionalities.title: Inline Printing
functionalities.desc: Suppresses trailing newline for continuous line progress bars and streaming prompts.
functionalities.code:
display "Loading modules: " ?inline ?color=#38bdf8
display "100% complete" ?color=#22c55e

parameters.name: expressions
parameters.desc: One or more comma-separated values to display.

example:
display "=== System Telemetry ===" ?color=#bd00ff
display "Uptime: 99.98%" ?color=#00FFCC
display "Load Avg: 0.12" ?color=#38bdf8

name: prompt
title: prompt — Interactive User Input
summary: Suspends execution to receive interactive user input from stdin, terminal, or IDE interactive runbox.

functionalities.title: Interactive Console Input
functionalities.desc: Prompts the operator and reads a full line of text until carriage return or newline.
functionalities.code:
set name : prompt "Enter your name: "
display "Welcome, " + name + "!" ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Numeric Parsing with Input
functionalities.desc: Reads user input and parses into a numeric variable for arithmetic computation.
functionalities.code:
set rawAge : prompt "Enter your age: "
set num age : num(rawAge)
display "In 5 years you will be: " + (age + 5) ?color=#38bdf8

parameters.name: message (optional)
parameters.desc: The invitation string displayed before reading stdin.

returns: str — The line entered by the operator.
example:
set command : prompt "vrs> "
if command == "exit" then
  display "Exiting session." ?color=#ef4444
else
  display "Executing: " + command ?color=#00FFCC
end

name: def
title: def — General Procedure and Method Definition
summary: Declares a callable procedure or function block. Can have side effects, accept arguments, and return values with reply.

functionalities.title: Standard Procedure Definition
functionalities.desc: Creates a named reusable code routine with scoped parameters.
functionalities.code:
def calculateHypotenuse(a, b):
  reply sqrt(a^2 + b^2)

set hyp : calculateHypotenuse(3, 4)
display "Hypotenuse: " + hyp ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Multi-Argument Function with Logic
functionalities.desc: Defines logic containing loops, conditionals, and error guards inside the procedure body.
functionalities.code:
def findMax(arr):
  set maxVal : arr[0]
  loop item in arr:
    if item > maxVal then set maxVal : item
  reply maxVal

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.desc: Formal parameter names enclosed in parentheses.

returns: Value specified by the reply statement, or null if void.
example:
def greet(name, role):
  display "Operator: " + name + " [" + role + "]" ?color=#38bdf8
  reply true

greet("Dr. Aris", "Lead Scientist")

name: func
title: func — Pure Function Contract
summary: Enforces deterministic pure function semantics: zero global side effects, referential transparency, and deterministic outputs.

functionalities.title: Pure Mathematical Transformation
functionalities.desc: Guarantees no external variables are mutated; strictly operates on inputs and returns results.
functionalities.code:
func circleArea(radius):
  set const pi : 3.1415926535
  reply pi * radius^2

display circleArea(5) ?color=#00FFCC

example:
func factorial(n):
  if n <= 1 then reply 1
  reply n * factorial(n - 1)

display "5! = " + factorial(5) ?color=#22c55e

name: reply
title: reply — Function Return Statement
summary: Terminates the execution of the current procedure, method, or function, transmitting the resulting value back to the caller.

functionalities.title: Returning Values to Caller
functionalities.desc: Stops execution of the function immediately and passes the evaluated result back.

functionalities.title: Early Exit Guard
functionalities.desc: Exits prematurely when validation checks fail.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.desc: The value returned to the caller.

returns: Exits current frame and passes the operand.
example:
def isPrime(n):
  if n < 2 then reply false
  loop i from 2 to sqrt(n):
    if n % i == 0 then reply false
  reply true

name: do
title: do — Scoped Execution & Exception Shield
summary: Creates a protected execution block. When paired with 'unless', provides robust try/catch-style exception shielding against runtime errors.

functionalities.title: Exception Shielding (Protected Execution)
functionalities.desc: Catches critical errors without aborting the program, routing into recovery logic.
functionalities.code:
do:
  set res : 100 / 0
unless DivisionByZeroError:
  display "Interception: Cannot divide by zero!" ?color=#f59e0b
  set res : 0

functionalities.title: Isolated Local Scope Block
functionalities.desc: Executes a block with local variable isolation; variables declared inside do not leak outward.
functionalities.code:
do:
  set tempKey : "secret_token_123"
  display "Key loaded in isolated scope"
! tempKey is out of scope here

parameters.name: block
parameters.desc: The code executed within the protected frame.

returns: Result of block or recovery block.
example:
do:
  load Matrix
  set inv : Matrix.inv([[1, 2], [2, 4]])
unless SystemError:
  display "Singular matrix detected; fallback to pseudo-inverse." ?color=#ef4444

name: unless
title: unless — Exception Interception Handler
summary: Pairs with 'do' to intercept specific or general errors, executing recovery procedures when an exception occurs.

functionalities.title: Specific Error Interception
functionalities.desc: Catches only the named error type (e.g. MemoryAllocationError, FileError, DivisionByZeroError).
functionalities.code:
do:
  set data : Fs.read("non_existent.txt")
unless FileError:
  display "Missing file; loading defaults." ?color=#38bdf8

functionalities.title: Catch-All Runtime Interception
functionalities.desc: Omitting the error name catches any runtime or syntax error that occurs within the block.
functionalities.code:
do:
  riskyOperation()
unless:
  display "Handled generic failure cleanly." ?color=#f59e0b

example:
do:
  set res : 50 / divisor
unless DivisionByZeroError:
  set res : 999999
  display "Divisor was zero, defaulted to max." ?color=#f59e0b

name: loop
title: loop — Universal Iteration Engine
summary: Primary iteration construct in VerScript. Supports range iteration (from...to), step quantifiers (by), collection iteration, and fixed repeats.
syntax:
loop [var] from <start> to <end> [by <step>]:
  <body>

loop <item> in <collection>:
  <body>

loop <count>:
  <body>

functionalities.title: Range Iteration with 'from' and 'to'
functionalities.desc: Iterates inclusive integer bounds with an index variable.
functionalities.code:
loop i from 1 to 5:
  display "Index: " + i ?color=#38bdf8

functionalities.title: Custom Step with 'by'
functionalities.desc: Steps by a custom positive or negative stride through the range.
functionalities.code:
loop val from 10 to 0 by -2:
  display "Countdown: " + val ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Collection Traversal (in)
functionalities.desc: Iterates through array elements directly.
functionalities.code:
set fruits : ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry"]
loop fruit in fruits:
  display "Fruit: " + fruit

functionalities.title: Fixed Count Repeat
functionalities.desc: Executes the inner body a fixed number of times.
functionalities.code:
loop 3:
  display "Heartbeat ping..." ?color=#22c55e

example:
set primes : []
loop num from 2 to 20:
  set isP : true
  loop d from 2 to (num - 1):
    if num % d == 0 then set isP : false
  if isP then primes.push(num)
display "Primes: " + primes ?color=#00FFCC

name: if
title: if — Conditional Branching
summary: Evaluates a boolean condition, executing the 'then' block if true, or the optional 'else' block if false.

functionalities.title: Basic Conditional Branch
functionalities.desc: Executes code if expression evaluates to true.
functionalities.code:
if score >= 90 then
  display "Grade: A" ?color=#22c55e
else
  display "Keep practicing" ?color=#f59e0b

functionalities.title: One-Line Conditional
functionalities.desc: Compact inline branch execution.
functionalities.code: if temp > 100 then display "Overheating!" ?color=#ef4444

parameters.name: condition
parameters.desc: Expression evaluating to true or false.

returns: Branch result if used as expression.
example:
set speed : 120
if speed > 100 then
  display "ALERT: Speed limit exceeded!" ?color=#ef4444
else
  display "Speed within normal parameters." ?color=#22c55e

name: match
title: match — Pattern Matching and Multi-Case Branching
summary: Tests a subject against multiple pattern branches with structural deconstruction and type matching.

functionalities.title: Structural Multi-Case Matching
functionalities.desc: Replaces cumbersome if-else ladders with clean pattern branches.
functionalities.code:
set code : 200
match code with:
  case 200: display "OK" ?color=#22c55e
  case 404: display "Not Found" ?color=#f59e0b
  case 500: display "Server Error" ?color=#ef4444
  case _:   display "Unknown Code"

example:
set role : "admin"
match role with:
  case "admin": display "Full Root Permissions" ?color=#00FFCC
  case "user":  display "Standard Access" ?color=#38bdf8
  case _:       display "Guest Mode"

name: load
title: load — Dynamic Standard Library Loader
summary: Loads one or more VerScript standard libraries into the execution environment. Supports comma-separated multi-loading.

functionalities.title: Single Library Loading
functionalities.desc: Imports a specific standard library (e.g. Matrix, Crypto, Stats, Math, Fs, Json).
functionalities.code:
load Matrix
set m : Matrix.identity(3)
display m ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Multi-Library Batch Loading
functionalities.desc: Loads multiple modules in a single clean directive.
functionalities.code:
load Matrix, Crypto, Math, Stats
display "All 4 libraries loaded successfully!" ?color=#22c55e

parameters.name: libraries
parameters.desc: Names of stdlib modules to load.

example:
load Crypto, Json
set payload : Json.stringify({ user: "alex", role: "admin" })
set hash : Crypto.sha256(payload)
display "Payload Hash: " + hash ?color=#00FFCC

name: inject
title: inject — In-Line Polyglot Code Injection
summary: Executes embedded foreign language code directly within VerScript, with automatic cross-runtime variable marshalling.

functionalities.title: Embedded Python Execution
functionalities.desc: Invokes Python runtime and imports libraries like NumPy or SciPy directly.
functionalities.code:
inject python:
  import math
  print("Python computed pi:", math.pi)

functionalities.title: Embedded C Execution
functionalities.desc: Compiles and executes high-performance native C code in-process.
functionalities.code:
inject c:
  printf("Native C hardware execution\n");

parameters.name: language
parameters.desc: Target runtime (python, c, js, bash, rust).

returns: Exported foreign symbols or standard output.

name: guard
title: guard — Memory & Invariant Watchguard
summary: Establishes a reactive watchguard that monitors an invariant expression, immediately triggering alerts if violated.

functionalities.title: Invariant Assertions
functionalities.desc: Guarantees conditions remain true throughout a scope.
functionalities.code:
guard memoryUsage < 1000000:
  display "CRITICAL: Memory threshold exceeded!" ?color=#ef4444

example:
set num balance : 500
guard balance >= 0:
  display "Violation: Balance cannot be negative!" ?color=#ef4444
set balance : balance - 100

name: async
title: async — Asynchronous Task Execution
summary: Spawns an asynchronous concurrent worker thread or fiber, executing the block non-blockingly.
syntax:
async:
  <body>

set task : async def taskName():
  <body>

functionalities.title: Non-Blocking Background Worker
functionalities.desc: Spawns background tasks while the main thread continues.
functionalities.code:
async:
  Time.sleep(1000)
  display "Background task complete!" ?color=#22c55e
display "Main thread running immediately..." ?color=#00FFCC

example:
set ch : chan 5
async:
  send ch, "Hello from fiber!"
set msg : recv ch
display "Received: " + msg ?color=#00FFCC

name: chan
title: chan — CSP Concurrency Channel
summary: Creates a typed or buffered Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP) channel for thread-safe message passing.

functionalities.title: Thread-Safe Channel Creation
functionalities.desc: Allocates a message-passing queue used with send and recv.
functionalities.code:
set jobs : chan 10
send jobs, "Data payload 1"
set item : recv jobs

example:
set messages : chan 3
send messages, "MSG_1"
send messages, "MSG_2"
display recv messages ?color=#00FFCC
display recv messages ?color=#38bdf8

name: send
title: send — Transmit Message to Channel
summary: Pushes a message onto a concurrency channel. Blocks if the channel buffer is saturated.

functionalities.title: Channel Transmission
functionalities.desc: Sends a value across a concurrency channel to waiting receivers.
functionalities.code:
set mailbox : chan 5
send mailbox, "New Order Received"

example:
set queue : chan 2
send queue, 100
send queue, 200

name: recv
title: recv — Receive Message from Channel
summary: Pulls and consumes the next available message from a channel. Blocks if the channel is currently empty.

functionalities.title: Channel Message Consumption
functionalities.desc: Retrieves a value from a channel queue.
functionalities.code:
set payload : recv jobQueue
display "Processing: " + payload

returns: The message object read from the channel.
example:
set pipe : chan 1
send pipe, "Ping"
set reply : recv pipe
display reply ?color=#00FFCC

name: emit
title: emit — Dispatch Reactive Event
summary: Fires an event into the global or scoped reactive bus, immediately triggering all matching 'on' listeners.

functionalities.title: Reactive Event Dispatch
functionalities.desc: Triggers event handlers across the runtime asynchronously or synchronously.
functionalities.code: emit "user:login", { id: 101, username: "alex" }

example:
on "telemetry:alert", def(data):
  display "ALERT: " + data ?color=#ef4444

emit "telemetry:alert", "Overheating in core 3"

name: on
title: on — Register Reactive Event Listener
summary: Attaches a callback procedure to listen for specific events fired via 'emit'.

functionalities.title: Event Subscription
functionalities.desc: Listens for dispatched events and runs the handler with the event payload.
functionalities.code:
on "data:synced", def(payload):
  display "Data synchronization complete!" ?color=#22c55e

example:
on "payment:success", def(amount):
  display "Payment processed: $" + amount ?color=#22c55e

emit "payment:success", 450

name: when
title: when — Reactive Conditional Observer
summary: Monitors a reactive property or state expression, executing a reaction as soon as the condition transitions to true.

functionalities.title: Reactive State Transition Observer
functionalities.desc: Waits until a variable state satisfies a predicate before triggering.
functionalities.code:
when temperature > 85:
  display "Temperature warning active" ?color=#ef4444

example:
set fuelLevel : 10
when fuelLevel < 15:
  display "LOW FUEL: Refuel required immediately." ?color=#f59e0b

name: DataType
summary: Defines a custom named datatype with runtime validation constraints and invariant predicates.
syntax:
DataType <TypeName>:
  guard <expression_with_it>

DataType <Port>:
  guard it >= 1 && it <= 65535
details: The `DataType` construct enables domain-driven type invariants. Any assignment to a variable annotated with this type verifies the `guard` rule against `it` and throws `DataTypeError` upon violation.

parameters.name: TypeName
parameters.description: Name of the constrained custom type.

example:
DataType PositiveNum:
  guard it > 0

set PositiveNum count : 5
! set PositiveNum err : -1  (Throws DataTypeError)

name: alias
title: alias — Command and Identifier Aliasing
summary: Creates an alternate identifier or shortcut alias for existing keywords, standard libraries, or procedures.

functionalities.title: Keyword / Procedure Shortcut
functionalities.desc: Provides human-friendly naming or domain-specific language shorthand.
functionalities.code:
alias print : display
print "Aliased display keyword successfully!" ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: Library Alias
functionalities.desc: Shortens verbose standard library paths.
functionalities.code:
load Matrix
alias M : Matrix
set mat : M.identity(3)

example:
alias echo : display
echo "Hello via echo alias!" ?color=#38bdf8

name: class
title: class — Object-Oriented Blueprint
summary: Declares an object-oriented class with encapsulated fields, static properties, constructors, and instance methods.

functionalities.title: Class Blueprint Definition
functionalities.desc: Bundles state and behaviors into an instantiable type.

name: throw
title: throw — Raise Custom Exception
summary: Explicitly raises a named exception or custom error, interrupting standard execution and transferring control to an enclosing 'unless' block.

functionalities.title: Raising Built-in Errors
functionalities.desc: Triggers standard exceptions like AssertError, ScopeViolationError, etc.
functionalities.code:
if balance < amount then
  throw RuntimeError "Insufficient funds for withdrawal"

name: typeof
title: typeof — Runtime Type Reflection
summary: Returns the string primitive or class type name of any evaluated operand.

functionalities.title: Inspecting Primitive Types
functionalities.desc: Determines whether a value is 'num', 'str', 'bool', 'arr', 'entity', or a custom DataType.
functionalities.code:
display typeof 42 ?color=#38bdf8      ! "num"
display typeof "test" ?color=#38bdf8  ! "str"
display typeof [1, 2] ?color=#38bdf8  ! "arr"

example:
def printType(x):
  display "Type is: " + (typeof x) ?color=#00FFCC

name: Matrix
title: Matrix — High-Performance Linear Algebra
summary: Deterministic linear algebra and matrix operations: determinants, inverses, eigenvalues, decompositions, and element-wise arithmetic.
syntax:
load Matrix
Matrix.det(m)
Matrix.inv(m)
Matrix.mult(a, b)
Matrix.identity(n)

functionalities.title: Matrix Multiplication & Determinants
functionalities.desc: Fast native matrix manipulation with C99 determinism.
functionalities.code:
load Matrix
set A : [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
set det : Matrix.det(A)
set inv : Matrix.inv(A)
display "Determinant: " + det ?color=#00FFCC
display "Inverse: " + inv ?color=#38bdf8

functionalities.title: Identity and Zero Matrices
functionalities.desc: Generates square identity matrices and dimensioned zero matrices.
functionalities.code:
load Matrix
set I : Matrix.identity(3)
display I ?color=#22c55e

returns: Scalar number, transformed matrix array, or vector.
example:
load Matrix
set M : [[2, 1], [5, 7]]
display "Det: " + Matrix.det(M) ?color=#00FFCC
display "Trace: " + Matrix.trace(M) ?color=#38bdf8

name: Crypto
title: Crypto — Cryptographic Hashing and Security
summary: Cryptographic digest routines including SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, HMAC generation, and cryptographically secure random bytes.
syntax:
load Crypto
Crypto.sha256(text)
Crypto.sha512(text)
Crypto.hmac(key, data)
Crypto.randomBytes(count)

functionalities.title: SHA-256 Digest Computation
functionalities.desc: Computes standard hex-encoded 256-bit hash of string data.
functionalities.code:
load Crypto
set digest : Crypto.sha256("admin_password_2026")
display "Digest: " + digest ?color=#00FFCC

functionalities.title: HMAC Authentication Signatures
functionalities.desc: Generates keyed HMAC digests for API signature verification.
functionalities.code:
load Crypto
set sig : Crypto.hmac("secret_key", "POST /api/v1/trade")
display "Signature: " + sig ?color=#22c55e

example:
load Crypto
set token : Crypto.sha256("user_token_seed")
display "Generated Token: " + token ?color=#00FFCC

name: Stats
title: Stats — Statistical Analysis & Probabilities
summary: Descriptive statistics, variance, standard deviation, linear regression, median, quartiles, and correlation.
syntax:
load Stats
Stats.mean(arr)
Stats.median(arr)
Stats.variance(arr)
Stats.stdDev(arr)

functionalities.title: Descriptive Statistics
functionalities.desc: Calculates average, median, variance, and standard deviation.
functionalities.code:
load Stats
set scores : [88, 92, 79, 95, 100, 85]
display "Mean: " + Stats.mean(scores) ?color=#00FFCC
display "StdDev: " + Stats.stdDev(scores) ?color=#38bdf8

example:
load Stats
set samples : [12, 15, 18, 22, 30]
display "Median: " + Stats.median(samples) ?color=#22c55e

name: Fs
title: Fs — File System Operations
summary: Synchronous and asynchronous file I/O: reading text/binary files, writing files, directory traversal, and path checking.
syntax:
load Fs
Fs.read(path)
Fs.write(path, data)
Fs.exists(path)
Fs.list(dirPath)

functionalities.title: Reading and Writing Text Files
functionalities.desc: Loads file content into string variables and writes content to disk.
functionalities.code:
load Fs
Fs.write("output.log", "System started successfully\n")
set content : Fs.read("output.log")
display content ?color=#22c55e

returns: str / arr / bool depending on method.
example:
load Fs
if Fs.exists("config.json") then
  set cfg : Fs.read("config.json")
  display "Loaded config." ?color=#00FFCC

name: Json
title: Json — JSON Serialization and Parsing
summary: Converts VerScript arrays and entity objects to standard JSON strings, and parses JSON strings into native data structures.

functionalities.title: Serialization & Deserialization
functionalities.desc: Marshals VerScript structures to/from standard JSON text.
functionalities.code:
load Json
set raw : '{"status":"ok","code":200}'
set data : Json.parse(raw)
display "Code: " + data.code ?color=#22c55e

set serialized : Json.stringify(data, true)
display serialized ?color=#38bdf8

parameters.name: data
parameters.desc: Object to stringify or JSON string to parse.

example:
load Json
set user : { id: 1, name: "Ada Lovelace", verified: true }
set jsonStr : Json.stringify(user)
display jsonStr ?color=#00FFCC

name: MemoryAllocationError
title: MemoryAllocationError — Allocation Failure
summary: Raised when the operating system or native allocator refuses memory requests due to heap exhaustion or bounds violations.
causes: Requested buffer exceeds available physical RAM; infinite recursive allocation loops.
remedy: Check array bounds, verify recursion termination conditions, and free tracked references.
example:
do:
  ! Allocate safe size
  set safeArr : [1, 2, 3, 4]
unless MemoryAllocationError:
  display "System low on memory; terminating buffers." ?color=#ef4444

name: DivisionByZeroError
title: DivisionByZeroError — Divide or Modulo by Zero
summary: Triggered whenever an arithmetic division (/) or remainder (%) operation receives a zero denominator.
causes: Dividing a numeric value by 0 or 0.0.
remedy: Guard divisors with an if check or enclose within a do...unless DivisionByZeroError block.
example:
do:
  set res : 100 / divisor
unless DivisionByZeroError:
  display "Cannot divide by zero!" ?color=#f59e0b
  set res : 0

name: UndefinedVariableError
title: UndefinedVariableError — Unbound Identifier Read
summary: Raised when accessing an identifier that has not been declared with 'set', 'def', or passed as an argument in the current scope.
causes: Typo in variable name; accessing a variable outside the block where it was declared.
remedy: Declare variables before reading, check scope boundaries, and review variable spelling.
example:
do:
  set val : missingVar
unless UndefinedVariableError:
  display "Variable was not defined; fallback activated." ?color=#f59e0b

name: ScopeViolationError
title: ScopeViolationError — Scope or Purity Boundary Breach
summary: Raised when pure functions (func) attempt to mutate external variables or access private/unscoped identifiers.
causes: Mutating outer scope from inside a pure 'func' or accessing 'private' members externally.
remedy: Keep pure functions referentially transparent, or switch to 'def' for procedures with side effects.
example:
set globalCount : 0
! Inside func, modifying globalCount raises ScopeViolationError

name: DataTypeError
title: DataTypeError — Invariant Constraint Breach
summary: Raised when assigning a value to a DataType-annotated variable that violates the declared type or guard invariant.
causes: Assigning string to num; violating guard predicate in custom DataType.
remedy: Ensure assigned values satisfy DataType guard conditions before assignment.
example:
DataType PositiveNum:
  val : num
  guard val > 0

do:
  set PositiveNum p : -5
unless DataTypeError:
  display "Validation caught negative value!" ?color=#ef4444

name: Printing and Console Output
title: How to Print and Format Output in VerScript
summary: Methods for streaming formatted text, numbers, arrays, and Truecolor ANSI styled messages to the terminal.
example:
display "Default white text"
display "Cyan highlighted text" ?color=#00FFCC
display "Loading: " ?inline ?color=#38bdf8
display "Done!" ?color=#22c55e

name: Exception Handling & Error Shielding
title: How to Catch and Shield Exceptions in VerScript
summary: Using the 'do...unless' block architecture to intercept runtime errors, prevent crashes, and implement graceful recovery fallbacks.
example:
do:
  set result : riskyCalculation()
unless DivisionByZeroError:
  display "Caught division by zero; setting default." ?color=#f59e0b
  set result : 0
unless:
  display "Caught unexpected error." ?color=#ef4444
  set result : null

name: Loops, Ranges, and Iteration
title: How to Iterate and Loop Over Numbers and Arrays
summary: Iterating ranges with 'from...to', stepping with 'by', repeating fixed counts, and iterating arrays with 'in'.
example:
! Loop with step
loop i from 0 to 10 by 2:
  display "Even number: " + i ?color=#38bdf8

! Array iteration
loop item in ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"]:
  display "Item: " + item ?color=#00FFCC

name: Linear Algebra & Matrix Math
title: How to Compute Matrix Inverses, Determinants, and Multiplications
summary: Using the Matrix standard library for high-speed deterministic operations on 2D arrays.
example:
load Matrix
set A : [[4, 7], [2, 6]]

summary: Represents the intentional absence of any value or uninitialized object reference.

name: header
summary: Defines an interface contract specification declaring prototypes and type constraints in *.h.vrs files.
details: Header specifications enforce compile-time and runtime contracts between callers and implementations. Companion headers (<file>.h.vrs) are automatically detected and verified against implementations (<file>.vrs).

parameters.name: ContractName
parameters.description: Name of the header specification block.

example:

  def func add(a: num, b: num): num
  def func mul(a: num, b: num): num

name: contract
summary: Declares an invariant behavioral specification for functions, structs, or libraries.
details: Enforces Design by Contract (DbC). Contracts guarantee preconditions before routines execute and postconditions after return.
example:
contract SafeDivision:
  require: denominator != 0
  ensure: it != nil

name: require
summary: Specifies a precondition predicate that must evaluate to true prior to executing a routine.
details: If the `require` predicate evaluates to false or 0 upon entering a routine, the runtime immediately throws a `PreconditionViolationError`.

name: ensure
summary: Specifies a postcondition predicate that must evaluate to true after routine completion before returning to caller.
details: Validates return values (accessible via `it`) and state postconditions. A false condition raises `PostconditionViolationError`.

name: include
summary: Explicitly imports and binds an external *.h.vrs header contract specification into the current compilation unit.
details: Loads header prototypes and validates all function implementations against declared signatures.

parameters.name: headerPath
parameters.description: Relative or absolute file path to the *.h.vrs file.

details: Evaluates numerical order and lexicographical string order.
example:
if age >= 18 then:
  display "Adult"

name: && (Logical AND)
summary: Short-circuiting logical conjunction. Evaluates to true only if both operands are truthy.
details: If `a` evaluates to false, `b` is short-circuited and not evaluated.
example:
if user.isLoggedIn && user.hasPermission then:
  display "Access Granted"

name: || (Logical OR)
summary: Short-circuiting logical disjunction. Evaluates to true if either operand is truthy.
details: If `a` is true, returns true immediately without evaluating `b`.
example:
if cache.exists || fetchRemote() then:
  display "Data ready"

name: ! (Logical NOT / Comment Prefix)
summary: Logical negation operator in expressions (!expr); also line comment prefix when starting a line (! comment).
details: Dual functionality in VerScript: (1) Inside expressions: inverts boolean truthiness (!true == false), (2) At start of line: denotes a line comment.
example:
! This is a VerScript comment line
set bool flag : false
if !flag then:
  display "Flag was false"

name: ?. (Safe Navigation)
summary: Safe property or method navigation; returns nil without throwing an error if the receiver is nil.
details: Prevents NullPointer / UndefinedVariable errors when traversing deeply nested optional structures.
example:
set city : user?.profile?.address?.city ?? "Unknown City"
display city

name: ?? (Nullish Coalescing)
summary: Returns the right-hand operand if the left operand is nil or empty, otherwise returns the left operand.
details: Provides a robust fallback mechanism for optional or uninitialized variables.

parameters.name: default_value
parameters.description: Fallback value if expr is nil.

example:
set port : config.port ?? 8080
display "Running on port: " + port

name: : (Assignment & Block Colon)
summary: Binds values to variables (set x: 42) and marks indented block headers (if cond:, loop 5:).
details: The fundamental syntactic pillar of VerScript: (1) Replaces the equal sign `=` for variable assignments, (2) Introduces Python-style indented blocks.

name: ? (Directive / Flag Marker)
summary: Prefixes modifier flags and inline parameters on statements (e.g. ?color=cyan, ?default=25, ?override).
details: VerScript statements support inline keyword options prefixed by `?` to configure visual formatting or execution flags.
example:
display "Success!" ?color=green ?bold
prompt username ?default="Guest"

name: . (Member Access)
summary: Accesses a property or invokes a method on an entity, library, string, or array instance.
details: Standard dot-operator notation for object-oriented dispatch, library routine calls (Matrix.det), and property reading.
example:
load Math
set radius : 5
set circ : 2 * Math.PI * radius

name: construct
summary: Constructor block or routine automatically invoked when instantiating a class or library entity.
syntax:
class <Name> <arg1> <arg2>:
  construct:
    set this.<field1> : <arg1>
    set this.<field2> : <arg2>

lib <LibName> <arg1>:
  construct:
    ...
details: The constructor initializes an entity's dynamic state upon creation. Parameters passed into `MyClass(a, b)` or `MyLib(a, b)` are bound in scope and available to initialize `this` properties. Constructors require no arguments of their own because class/lib arguments are attached directly to the definition.
example:
class Vector2D x y:
  construct:
    set this.x : x
    set this.y : y
  def func magnitude:
    reply Math.sqrt(this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y)

set v : Vector2D(3, 4)
display v.magnitude()  ! 5

name: this
summary: Implicit reference to the current entity instance executing a method or constructor.
details: Within `class` and `lib` methods and constructors, `this` binds to the active instance state and dynamic member variables.

name: Matrix (Constructor & Class)
summary: Linear algebra library and matrix class supporting constructors, determinants, matrix multiplication, inversion, and decomposition.
syntax:
load Matrix
set m : Matrix(rows, cols, defaultValue)
Matrix.det(m)
Matrix.identity(n)
details: `Matrix` can be used statically (`Matrix.multiply(A, B)`) or instantiated as an entity (`set m : Matrix(3, 3, 0); m.det()`).
example:
load Matrix
set m : Matrix.identity(3)
display "Determinant: " + Matrix.det(m)

name: Vector (Constructor & Class)
summary: 2D, 3D, and n-dimensional geometric vector library and class (dot product, cross product, magnitude, normalize).
syntax:
load Vector
set v : Vector(x, y, z)
v.magnitude()
Vector.dot(v1, v2)
details: Provides high-speed vector arithmetic. Supports instance method calls (`v.magnitude()`) as well as static library functions (`Vector.cross(u, v)`).
example:
load Vector
set v1 : Vector(1, 0, 0)
set v2 : Vector(0, 1, 0)
set v3 : Vector.cross(v1, v2)
display v3.z  ! 1

name: Json.parse / Json.stringify
summary: Parses JSON text into VerScript entities and arrays, or serializes data into formatted JSON strings.
syntax:
load Json
set data : Json.parse(jsonString)
set text : Json.stringify(data)
details: Standard JSON parser and serializer with support for nested arrays, dictionaries, numbers, and escape characters.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: JSON string to parse, or entity to serialize.

example:
load Json
set obj : Json.parse('{"name": "VerScript", "version": 2}')
display obj.name

name: Fs.readFile / Fs.writeFile
summary: Reads, writes, and manages files and directories on the local host filesystem.
syntax:
load Fs
set content : Fs.readFile("data.txt")
Fs.writeFile("output.txt", content)
Fs.exists("data.txt")
details: Provides direct filesystem access. Automatically handles file descriptors, binary buffers, and text encodings.

name: OutputTypeError
title: OutputTypeError — Auto-Registered Exception
summary: Compiler error exception registered in src/main.c.
causes: Triggered by runtime or syntax violation during evaluation.
remedy: Guard with do...unless OutputTypeError block or validate inputs.
example:
do:
  ! Operation
unless OutputTypeError:
  display "Caught OutputTypeError" ?color=#f59e0b

name: OutputTypeMissingError
title: OutputTypeMissingError — Auto-Registered Exception
summary: Compiler error exception registered in src/main.c.
causes: Triggered by runtime or syntax violation during evaluation.
remedy: Guard with do...unless OutputTypeMissingError block or validate inputs.
example:
do:
  ! Operation
unless OutputTypeMissingError:
  display "Caught OutputTypeMissingError" ?color=#f59e0b

name: OutputExistenceError
title: OutputExistenceError — Auto-Registered Exception
summary: Compiler error exception registered in src/main.c.
causes: Triggered by runtime or syntax violation during evaluation.
remedy: Guard with do...unless OutputExistenceError block or validate inputs.
example:
do:
  ! Operation
unless OutputExistenceError:
  display "Caught OutputExistenceError" ?color=#f59e0b

name: ComplexMathError
title: ComplexMathError — Auto-Registered Exception
summary: Compiler error exception registered in src/main.c.
causes: Triggered by runtime or syntax violation during evaluation.
remedy: Guard with do...unless ComplexMathError block or validate inputs.
example:
do:
  ! Operation
unless ComplexMathError:
  display "Caught ComplexMathError" ?color=#f59e0b

name: and
title: and — Short-Circuit Logical Conjunction
summary: Evaluates whether two boolean expressions are both true, short-circuiting evaluation if the left operand is false.
returns: bool (true if both operands evaluate to true)
example:
isValid : true
isAdmin : true
if isValid and isAdmin:
    display "Access Granted" ?color=#00FFCC

name: or
title: or — Short-Circuit Logical Disjunction
summary: Evaluates whether at least one of two boolean expressions is true, short-circuiting if the left operand is true.
returns: bool (true if either operand is true)
example:
isOwner : false
isModerator : true
if isOwner or isModerator:
    display "Action Allowed" ?color=#00FFCC

name: not
title: not — Unary Logical Inversion
summary: Inverts the truth value of a boolean expression.

name: nand
title: nand — Negated Logical AND Gate
summary: Returns false only when both operands are true; otherwise returns true.
example:
flagA : true
flagB : true
result : flagA nand flagB
display "NAND Result: " + result  ! Displays false

name: nor
title: nor — Negated Logical OR Gate
summary: Returns true only when both operands are false; otherwise returns false.
example:
a : false
b : false
if a nor b:
    display "Both are inactive" ?color=#38bdf8

name: xor
title: xor — Exclusive Disjunction
summary: Returns true if exactly one operand is true and the other is false.
example:
hasCoupon : true
hasDiscount : false
if hasCoupon xor hasDiscount:
    display "Valid single promotion" ?color=#10b981

name: xnor
title: xnor — Logical Equivalence / Negated XOR
summary: Returns true if both operands have identical boolean truth values.
example:
stateA : true
stateB : true
if stateA xnor stateB:
    display "States are synchronized" ?color=#00FFCC

name: xand
title: xand — Cross Logical Conjunction
summary: Specialized non-associative logical conjunction operator for strict truth state validation.
example:
cond1 : true
cond2 : true
res : cond1 xand cond2
display "XAND: " + res

name: true
title: true — Canonical Boolean Truth Value
summary: Represents the standard boolean true constant in expressions and logical evaluations.
example:
isActive : true
display "System active: " + isActive

name: false
title: false — Canonical Boolean Falsity Value
summary: Represents the standard boolean false constant in expressions and logical evaluations.
example:
isPaused : false
display "Paused: " + isPaused

name: then
title: then — Consequent Conditional Action
summary: Specifies the immediate execution statement following an if condition on the same line.
example:
score : 95
if score >= 90 then display "Honor Roll!" ?color=#00FFCC

name: else
title: else — Alternative Execution Branch
summary: Executes an alternate block of code when an preceding if or unless condition is not satisfied.

name: with
title: with — Contextual Binding & Match Target
summary: Binds expression targets into match evaluation or scoped contextual resources.
example:
role : "admin"
match role with:
    case "admin": display "Superuser Access"
    case "guest": display "Read Only"
    case _: display "Unknown Role"

name: case
title: case — Pattern Matching Branch Selector
summary: Defines an individual matching branch and statement within a match expression.
example:
code : 200
match code with:
    case 200: display "OK"
    case 404: display "Not Found"
    case _: display "Server Error"

name: in
title: in — Membership Predicate & Range Iterator
summary: Specifies range or collection iteration in loop headers and tests for element inclusion.
example:
for num in [10, 20, 30]:
    display "Number: " + num

name: is
title: is — Dynamic Type & State Predicate
summary: Tests whether a variable conforms to a primitive type or numeric characteristic (even/odd).
parameters: expression (any), type (num, str, bool, arr, entity, even, odd)

name: even
title: even — Even Integer Predicate
summary: Used alongside the 'is' operator to test if an integer is divisible by 2.

name: odd
title: odd — Odd Integer Predicate
summary: Used alongside the 'is' operator to test if an integer is not divisible by 2.

name: iterate
title: iterate — Explicit Sequence Driver
summary: Initiates explicit iteration across numeric ranges or collection items.
syntax:
iterate from start to end by step:
    ...
example:
iterate from 1 to 5:
    display "Step count"

name: yield
title: yield — Generator Value Suspension
summary: Suspends function execution and yields an intermediate value to the consumer.

name: extern
title: extern — Dynamic Win32 / Native Shared Library FFI
summary: Declares and binds external dynamic symbols from system DLLs (e.g. kernel32.dll) for direct runtime invocation.
returns: Native integer or pointer return value
example:
extern "kernel32.dll" GetCurrentProcessId()
pid : GetCurrentProcessId()
display "Native Win32 Process ID: " + pid ?color=#00FFCC

name: lib
title: lib — Modular Library Definition
summary: Declares a reusable library namespace containing exported functions, classes, and constants.

name: library
title: library — Canonical Module Definition Alias
summary: Full keyword alias for declaring modular library units and namespaces.

name: pkg
title: pkg — Package Declaration & Scoping
summary: Encapsulates source units into a distribution package namespace for the VerScript Package Manager.
example:
pkg org.verscript.net
lib HttpClient:
    ...

name: config
title: config — Compiler & Runtime Directive Block
summary: Declares execution configuration options, optimization levels, or runtime constraints for a script.
example:
config:
    strictTypes : true
    optimize : 2

name: extends
title: extends — DataType Specialization & Inheritance
summary: Inherits and extends fields and methods from a base DataType or Class.
example:
DataType Employee extends Person:
    department : str

name: unpack
title: unpack — Structured Destructuring Assignment
summary: Unpacks elements from an array or entity fields directly into multiple variables.
parameters: Target variable list and source collection
example:
coords : [100, 250]
unpack [x, y] : coords
display "X: " + x + ", Y: " + y

name: ceil
title: ceil — Ceiling Rounding
summary: Rounds a numeric floating-point value upward to the nearest integer.
example:
val : 4.12
display ceil(val)  ! Outputs 5

name: floor
title: floor — Floor Rounding
summary: Rounds a numeric value downward to the nearest integer.
example:
val : 8.89
display floor(val)  ! Outputs 8

name: round
title: round — Nearest Integer Rounding
summary: Rounds a number to the nearest integer value using standard half-up rounding.
example: display round(7.5)  ! Outputs 8

name: clamp
title: clamp — Range Value Boundary Clamping
summary: Constrains a value within a specified minimum and maximum range.
example:
hp : clamp(currentHp, 0, 100)
display "Health: " + hp

name: min
title: min — Minimum Value Determination
summary: Returns the lesser of two values, or the smallest item in an array.
parameters: a (num), b (num) or array of nums
example: display min(14, 29)  ! Outputs 14

name: max
title: max — Maximum Value Determination
summary: Returns the greater of two values, or the largest item in an array.
parameters: a (num), b (num) or array of nums
example: display max(14, 29)  ! Outputs 29

name: exp
title: exp — Natural Exponential Function
summary: Computes e raised to the power of x ($e^x$).
example: display exp(1)  ! Approximately 2.71828

name: ln
title: ln — Natural Logarithm (Base e)
summary: Computes the natural logarithm (base e) of a positive number.
example: display ln(2.71828)  ! Approximately 1.0

name: log2
title: log2 — Binary Logarithm (Base 2)
summary: Computes the base-2 logarithm of a positive number.
example: display log2(256)  ! Outputs 8

name: sqrt
title: sqrt — Square Root
summary: Computes the principal non-negative square root of a number.
example: display sqrt(144)  ! Outputs 12

name: rt
title: rt — Arbitrary n-th Root
summary: Computes the arbitrary n-th root of a number.
example: display rt(27, 3)  ! Cube root = 3

name: hypot
title: hypot — Euclidean Distance Hypotenuse
summary: Computes $sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$ without intermediate overflow or underflow.
example:
dist : hypot(3, 4)
display "Hypotenuse: " + dist  ! Outputs 5

name: gcd
title: gcd — Greatest Common Divisor
summary: Computes the largest positive integer that divides two given integers without a remainder.
example: display gcd(48, 18)  ! Outputs 6

name: hcf
title: hcf — Highest Common Factor
summary: Canonical alias for gcd.
example: display hcf(36, 60)  ! Outputs 12

name: lcm
title: lcm — Least Common Multiple
summary: Computes the smallest positive integer that is divisible by both given numbers.
example: display lcm(12, 15)  ! Outputs 60

name: sin
title: sin — Trigonometric Sine (Radians)
summary: Computes the trigonometric sine of an angle given in radians.
example: display sin(pi / 2)  ! Outputs 1

name: cos
title: cos — Trigonometric Cosine (Radians)
summary: Computes the trigonometric cosine of an angle in radians.
example: display cos(0)  ! Outputs 1

name: tan
title: tan — Trigonometric Tangent (Radians)
summary: Computes the trigonometric tangent of an angle in radians.
example: display tan(pi / 4)  ! Approximately 1

name: sinDeg
title: sinDeg / sindeg — Trigonometric Sine (Degrees)
summary: Computes the sine of an angle directly specified in degrees.
example: display sinDeg(90)  ! Outputs 1

name: cosDeg
title: cosDeg / cosdeg — Trigonometric Cosine (Degrees)
summary: Computes the cosine of an angle directly specified in degrees.
example: display cosDeg(0)  ! Outputs 1

name: degToRad
title: degToRad / degtorad — Degrees to Radians Conversion
summary: Converts an angle from degrees to radians ($d 	imes  rac{pi}{180}$).
example:
rad : degToRad(180)
display rad  ! Approximately 3.14159

name: radToDeg
title: radToDeg / radtodeg — Radians to Degrees Conversion
summary: Converts an angle from radians to degrees ($r 	imes  rac{180}{pi}$).
example:
deg : radToDeg(pi)
display deg  ! Outputs 180

name: sign
title: sign / sgn — Signum Function
summary: Extracts the sign of a number, returning -1 for negative numbers, 0 for zero, and +1 for positive numbers.
example:
display sign(-42)  ! Outputs -1
display sgn(10)   ! Outputs 1

name: divRem
title: divRem / divrem — Combined Division and Remainder
summary: Computes integer quotient and remainder simultaneously, returning a two-element tuple `[quotient, remainder]`.
example:
res : divRem(17, 5)
display "Quotient: " + res[0] + ", Remainder: " + res[1]

name: isEven
title: isEven / iseven — Functional Even Predicate
summary: Functional call checking if an integer is even.
example: display isEven(10)  ! true

name: isOdd
title: isOdd / isodd — Functional Odd Predicate
summary: Functional call checking if an integer is odd.
example: display isOdd(7)  ! true

name: lerp
title: lerp — Linear Interpolation
summary: Calculates the linear interpolation between point a and point b for parameter t ($a + (b - a) 	imes t$).
example:
mid : lerp(0, 100, 0.5)
display "Midpoint: " + mid  ! Outputs 50

name: pi
title: pi — Archimedes' Mathematical Constant
summary: Standard mathematical ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter ($approx 3.141592653589793$).
example: circumference : 2 * pi * radius

name: tau
title: tau — Full Turn Circle Constant (2π)
summary: The circle constant representing one full turn in radians ($2pi approx 6.283185307179586$).
example: angle : tau * 0.25  ! Quarter turn (90 deg)

name: phi
title: phi — Golden Ratio Constant
summary: The golden ratio constant $ rac{1 + sqrt{5}}{2} approx 1.618033988749895$.
example: goldenWidth : height * phi

name: inf
title: inf / infinity — Positive Infinity Constant
summary: Represents positive infinity in IEEE floating-point arithmetic and numeric limits.

name: complex
title: complex — Complex Number Constructor
summary: Instantiates a complex number with real and imaginary parts ($a + bi$).
example:
z : complex(3, 4)
display "Complex: " + z

name: real
title: real — Extract Real Component
summary: Extracts the real component from a complex number instance.
example:
z : complex(5, -2)
display "Real: " + real(z)  ! Outputs 5

name: imag
title: imag — Extract Imaginary Component
summary: Extracts the imaginary component coefficient from a complex number instance.
example:
z : complex(5, -2)
display "Imag: " + imag(z)  ! Outputs -2

name: conj
title: conj — Complex Conjugate
summary: Computes the complex conjugate of $a + bi$, returning $a - bi$.
example:
z : complex(3, 4)
z_star : conj(z)
display "Conjugate: " + z_star  ! 3 - 4i

name: terminal
title: terminal — Console & Terminal Subsystem Controller
summary: Accesses terminal control properties, cursor navigation, clear screen, and ANSI buffers.
example:
terminal.title("VerScript Studio Server")
terminal.clear()

name: close
title: close — Close Stream, Channel, or Session
summary: Closes an active file handle, network socket, concurrency channel, or terminal session.
example:
ch : chan<num>(5)
close(ch)

name: flush
title: flush — Flush Output Buffers
summary: Forces all pending output stream buffers to be written immediately to the console or file.
example:
display "Computing..." ?inline=true
flush()

name: focus
title: focus — Direct Viewport or Pane Focus
summary: Directs keyboard and cursor focus to a specified UI element, window pane, or terminal view.
example: terminal.focus("output-pane")

name: title
title: title — Set Window or Document Title
summary: Sets the application window title or terminal tab title string.
example: title "VerScript Simulator v2.0"

name: split
title: split — Split Panes or Delimited Strings
summary: Dual-purpose keyword: splits strings by a delimiter or splits terminal viewports into tiled panes.
returns: arr of strings or new pane handle
example:
words : "apple,banana,orange".split(",")
display words[0]

name: render
title: render — Trigger Frame Rasterization
summary: Initiates rasterization of active scene geometry and visual elements onto the screen canvas.
example: render(mainScene, mainCamera)

name: screen
title: screen — Canvas & Viewport Surface Descriptor
summary: Configures and accesses the graphics display surface resolution, refresh rate, and pixel buffers.
example: screen(800, 600, "VerScript 2D Sandbox")

name: world
title: world — 3D Spatial Container & Physics Environment
summary: Defines the 3D spatial simulation coordinate space and physics world settings.
example: simWorld : world([0, -9.8, 0])

name: draw
title: draw — Immediate-Mode Shape Rendering
summary: Issues immediate 2D drawing instructions for geometric primitives.
example: draw rect(100, 100, 50, 50) ?fill=#00FFCC

name: spawn
title: spawn — Instantiate Scene Entity
summary: Spawns a game object, actor, or geometry mesh into the active scene hierarchy.
example: player : spawn Entity("Hero") at [0, 0, 0]

name: camera
title: camera — Viewport Projection & Camera Controller
summary: Constructs and positions a virtual perspective or orthographic camera.
parameters: fov (field of view in degrees), aspect (aspect ratio)
example:
cam : camera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 1000)
cam.position : [0, 5, 10]

name: light
title: light — Illumination Source Descriptor
summary: Adds ambient, directional, or point lighting to a 3D scene.
example: sun : light("sun", #FFFFFF, 1.2)

name: scene
title: scene — Scene Graph Container
summary: Container managing all entities, lights, meshes, and cameras for a visual frame.
example:
lvl : scene()
lvl.add(sun)
lvl.add(player)

name: rect
title: rect — 2D Rectangle Geometry Primitive
summary: Constructs a 2D rectangular shape with position, width, and height.

name: circle
title: circle — 2D Circle Geometry Primitive
summary: Constructs a 2D circle with center coordinates and radius.
example: coin : circle(150, 150, 25)

name: line
title: line — Vector Line Segment
summary: Constructs a line segment between two coordinate points.

name: box
title: box — 3D Cuboid Mesh Primitive
summary: Constructs a 3D cuboid mesh with width, height, and depth dimensions.
example: crate : box(2, 2, 2)

name: sphere
title: sphere — 3D Spherical Mesh Primitive
summary: Constructs a 3D spherical mesh with a defined radius and radial segments.
example: orb : sphere(1.5, 32)

name: fill
title: fill — Surface Fill Color Specification
summary: Applies solid color, gradient, or texture fill to a 2D shape or material.
example: draw circle(100, 100, 40) ?fill=#BD00FF

name: stroke
title: stroke — Border & Outline Specification
summary: Specifies outline color and border width for drawing primitives.
example: draw rect(20, 20, 80, 80) ?stroke=#00FFCC ?strokeWidth=2

name: pixel
title: pixel — Direct Framebuffer Pixel Access
summary: Sets or retrieves raw RGBA pixel color at $(x, y)$ coordinate on the active surface.
example: screen.pixel(400, 300) : #00FFCC

name: frame
title: frame — Render Frame Clock & Delta Time
summary: Provides timing context and delta time ($Delta t$) within game loops and animation callbacks.
example:
on frame(dt):
    player.x : player.x + (speed * dt)

name: infinity
title: infinity — Full Keyword for Positive Infinity
summary: Represents positive infinity in numeric computations and upper limits.
example:
val : infinity
if x < val: display "Within bounds"

name: method
title: method — Object & Class Method Declaration
summary: Declares a member function within a class definition with access to instance state.

name: sgn
title: sgn — Signum Function Alias
summary: Returns -1 for negative numbers, 0 for zero, and +1 for positive numbers.
example: display sgn(-15)  ! Outputs -1

name: sync
title: sync — Synchronous Block Execution
summary: Blocks and synchronizes execution until an async task, promise, or channel completes.
example:
sync:
    display "Synchronous critical section"
